configEntries.description: Docker executable used to run Docker Compose commands.
Directory containing the Compose file. Import this bundle under another key to manage more than one project on a system.

scripts.name: Check Docker Compose Updates
scripts.description: Pulls pullable service images into Docker's local cache and reports running services whose image ID changed. Containers are not restarted.

steps.label: Check Docker Compose service images
steps.command:
docker_cmd="{{config.dockerCommand}}"
project_path="{{config.projectPath}}"
[ -n "$docker_cmd" ] || docker_cmd=docker
case "$project_path" in "~/"*) project_path="$HOME/${project_path#??}" ;; esac
cd "$project_path"
services="$("$docker_cmd" compose config --services)" || exit $?
image_format="$(printf '{''{.Image}''}')"
id_format="$(printf '{''{.Id}''}')"
before_file="$(mktemp)" || exit $?
trap 'rm -f "$before_file"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
for service in $services; do
  container_id="$("$docker_cmd" compose ps -q "$service")"
  [ -n "$container_id" ] || continue
  current_id="$("$docker_cmd" inspect --format "$image_format" "$container_id" 2>/dev/null)"
  [ -n "$current_id" ] && printf '%s %s\n' "$service" "$current_id" >> "$before_file"
done
"$docker_cmd" compose pull --quiet --ignore-buildable
for service in $services; do
  current_id="$(awk -v name="$service" '$1 == name { print $2; exit }' "$before_file")"
  [ -n "$current_id" ] || continue
  image_ref="$("$docker_cmd" compose config --images "$service" | head -n 1)"
  [ -n "$image_ref" ] || continue
  latest_id="$("$docker_cmd" image inspect --format "$id_format" "$image_ref" 2>/dev/null)"
  if [ -n "$latest_id" ] && [ "$current_id" != "$latest_id" ]; then
    current_version="$(printf '%s' "${current_id#sha256:}" | cut -c1-12)"
    latest_version="$(printf '%s' "${latest_id#sha256:}" | cut -c1-12)"
    printf 'LUDASH_UPDATE %s %s %s\n' "$service" "$current_version" "$latest_version"
  fi
done

scripts.name: Detect Docker Compose
scripts.description: Checks whether Docker Compose can read the configured project.

steps.label: Detect Docker Compose project
steps.command:
docker_cmd="{{config.dockerCommand}}"
project_path="{{config.projectPath}}"
[ -n "$docker_cmd" ] || docker_cmd=docker
case "$project_path" in "~/"*) project_path="$HOME/${project_path#??}" ;; esac
command -v "$docker_cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1 && cd "$project_path" && "$docker_cmd" compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$docker_cmd" compose config --services >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo found

scripts.name: List Docker Compose Services
scripts.description: Reports running Compose services and the image IDs used by their containers.

steps.label: List Docker Compose services
steps.command:
docker_cmd="{{config.dockerCommand}}"
project_path="{{config.projectPath}}"
[ -n "$docker_cmd" ] || docker_cmd=docker
case "$project_path" in "~/"*) project_path="$HOME/${project_path#??}" ;; esac
cd "$project_path"
services="$("$docker_cmd" compose config --services)" || exit $?
image_format="$(printf '{''{.Image}''}')"
for service in $services; do
  container_id="$("$docker_cmd" compose ps -q "$service")"
  [ -n "$container_id" ] || continue
  image_id="$("$docker_cmd" inspect --format "$image_format" "$container_id" 2>/dev/null)"
  [ -n "$image_id" ] || continue
  version="$(printf '%s' "${image_id#sha256:}" | cut -c1-12)"
  printf 'LUDASH_PACKAGE %s %s\n' "$service" "$version"
done

scripts.name: Update All Docker Compose Services
scripts.description: Pulls pullable images and recreates the Compose project with the new images.

steps.label: Update Docker Compose services
steps.command:
docker_cmd="{{config.dockerCommand}}"
project_path="{{config.projectPath}}"
[ -n "$docker_cmd" ] || docker_cmd=docker
case "$project_path" in "~/"*) project_path="$HOME/${project_path#??}" ;; esac
cd "$project_path"
"$docker_cmd" compose pull --quiet --ignore-buildable
"$docker_cmd" compose up -d --remove-orphans

scripts.name: Update Selected Docker Compose Services
scripts.description: Pulls and recreates only the selected Compose services, including their declared dependencies.

steps.label: Update selected Docker Compose services
steps.command:
docker_cmd="{{config.dockerCommand}}"
project_path="{{config.projectPath}}"
[ -n "$docker_cmd" ] || docker_cmd=docker
case "$project_path" in "~/"*) project_path="$HOME/${project_path#??}" ;; esac
cd "$project_path"
"$docker_cmd" compose pull --quiet --ignore-buildable --include-deps {{quotedPackages}}
"$docker_cmd" compose up -d {{quotedPackages}}
